summary: fix(settings): show a banner for WAF blocks instead of the unblock flow
description:
Because:
- Sign-in treated WAF 406/429 (errno 125/114) as an auth-server block
- An unblock code can't clear a WAF block, so users got stuck

This commit:
- Adds isWafBlockedError to fxa-auth-client
- Shows the blocked/throttled banner on sign-in for WAF errors

Closes #FXA-14758
